decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API has had its own page for two consecutive years, ties into the firm's announced messaging platform direction, and costs little to maintain, so the investment and public commitment favor keeping it.

Launched only in 2024 with its own page, the email-to-SMS gateway has had too little time to prove itself, so any weak results can still be blamed on the ramp-up period and the firm has reason to justify its recent launch decision.

The SMS-to-email gateway was publicly launched alongside its counterpart in 2024 and completes the firm's messaging gateway suite, so dropping it after one year would contradict the announced direction.
